organization.name: BinAiTech client - general contractor
organization.role: main contractor reporting on subcontracted work

audience: site manager and finance; drives progress payment to the supplier and continue/redo decisions on the slab

terminology.delivered: Concrete arrived on site. Supported by a delivery log only.
terminology.poured: Concrete was placed. Supported by a site record. Does NOT imply it conformed to spec.
terminology.conforming: Passed the required tests (e.g. slump within spec). Requires a test record. Delivery or pour alone is NOT conformity.
terminology.accepted: Formally accepted for structural use AFTER conformity is confirmed.
terminology.went fine: A subjective judgement, not evidence. Never report as fact.

rules.text: Every numeric claim must state its unit, its date/period, and at least one evidence record. A number without all three is unsupported.
A report stays draft until the officer approves it. Nothing here approves itself.
Never infer conformity or acceptance from delivery or pour alone. A test result is required to claim the work conformed.
Any failed or out-of-spec test result MUST be surfaced in the report. Never omit a failed test, even if the work proceeded.

status_definitions.supported: Backed by at least one evidence record; consistent across sources; satisfies R1.
status_definitions.conflicting: Two or more sources give different values for the same fact.
status_definitions.unsupported: No evidence record backs it, or it violates a rule (e.g. conformity claimed without a test).
status_definitions.uncertain: Partial evidence; cannot be confirmed or denied yet.
